summary: Implemented the terminal window title control. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) gated only on is_terminal, placed after set_alt_screen; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200; tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was run (no tests, mypy, or black) per instructions; all verification was by reading. Changes are uncommitted.
